35 Things I Can't Live Without! Actually, it's closer to 40, but that just seemed too extreme, so I decided a fib wouldn't hurt. Today we are looking at things APPARENTLY I can't live without -- things that are cool but also have been clogging up my studio and by extension -- life. I like them all, but I need to do a little organizing. OH -- and we're showing some very Snaily secrets. We'll be looking at Japanese selvedge denim, FoxFibre, Type III denim jackets, Maine-made moccasins, Italian sneakers, Finnish vegetable-tanned leather backpacks, the list goes on!
